eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Imperial; Kern; Los Angeles; Orange; Riverside; San Bernardino; San Diego; San Luis Obispo; Ventura, CA; at 3:26 PM on JUL 29, 2026 Effective until 5:26 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
AN AMBER ALERT IS BEING ISSUED BY THE CALIFORNIA HIGHWAY PATROL ON BEHALF OF THE RIDGECREST POLICE DEPARTMENT.

ON JULY 29, 2026 AT 1130 HOURS, MAXIMUS ROMAN, KAISER ROMAN AND HAILEE ROMAN WERE ABDUCTED FROM RIDGECREST, CALIFORNIA.  MAXIMUS IS A 10 YEAR OLD HISPANIC MALE, 4 FEET 7 INCHES TALL, WEIGHING 50 POUNDS, WITH BLACK HAIR AND BROWN EYES. KAISER IS A 8 YEAR OLD HISPANIC MALE, 4 FEET 6 INCHES TALL, WEIGHING 45 POUNDS, WITH BLACK HAIR AND BROWN EYES. HAILEE IS A 4 YEAR OLD HISPANIC FEMALE, 3 FEET 4 INCHES TALL, WEIGHING 30 POUNDS, WITH BLACK HAIR AND BROWN EYES.

THE SUSPECT, JULIO ROMAN GARCIA, IS A 29 YEAR OLD HISPANIC MALE, STANDING 5 FEET 11 INCHES TALL, WEIGHING 400 POUNDS WITH BLACK HAIR AND BROWN EYES. 

THE SUSPECT WAS LAST SEEN DRIVING A 2014 GRAY HONDA ACCORD, WITH CALIFORNIA LICENSE PLATE NUMBER 9RUN898.

IF SEEN CALL 9 1 1
